items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: Phineas was on the trumpet but he just wasn't playing that music and he was my best friend.

ctx.x: 13, 14, 15. I said I'm going to make this band and I was coming into high school too, so I studied the clarinet and the band what it seems those -- this boy's name, Phineas, Phineas was on the trumpet but he just wasn't playing that music and he was my best friend. I got that old cornet that I had and got -- looked at the chart and got down and started playing.

Now, we had -- in this band, we had -- at one point Albert Heights, a violinist, we had a pianist, beautiful pianist, he come from the southwest part of Washington, then we had a full band and by the way, we had a boy named Daniel Braseers(?) which later he became one of the greatest jazz trumpets that is known.
